messages:
ana: FYI were kicking off the docs localization pilot for SDK docs (zh, fr, de) and simultaneously removing the old inline example snippets from the monorepo. Preview is up: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/i18n-sdk-preview

mike: Removing inline examples means some language-specific samples will move to /examples-localized. Any migration guidance?
\sana: Yes  short plan: 1) move examples into examples-localized repo, 2) update docs to reference localized examples with language selector, 3) keep monorepo snippets for one release as read-only shims with warnings. Deprecation window = 3 weeks after canary.

tanvi: What about SDK references in code blocks that reference old paths? Will codemods run?
\sana: We'll run a lightweight codemod to update import paths and example links. Owners still need to approve PRs. Codemod outputs will be posted to #docs-review channel when ready.

mike: Telemetry / security check: will localization push any user data to external translation services?
\sana: No. All translations are done via our vendor in a private workspace; source content stays internal. We will not send customer prompts or keys. Only documentation text is sent, and only after manual review. There is an opt-out flag for teams running Private builds.
i18n-bot: i18n deploy scheduled: docs/sdk -> i18n-preview cluster at 2026-04-01T09:00:00Z (canary).

tanvi: Docs linter and link-checker required before merge?
\sana: Yes: docs linter, link-checker, and localized spellcheck must pass. Also require a reviewer who is fluent in the target language.

release-bot: Release note: docs localization is non-breaking; examples repo move will show deprecation notices in the monorepo for 1 release.

mike: I'll coordinate with eng to ensure example test runners in CI point to new paths.
\sana: Thanks. If you see any missing context in the previews (snippets, language notes), flag here. We'll start canary next week and aim for full rollout in 3 weeks. :shipit:
